jobs.description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.  

**PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE**
-----------------------

  

The SAP S/4HANA SD Reginal Application Consultant is responsible for providing SAP SD application support, continuous improvement, and rollout execution services for business units across the Americas region.
Working within an established global SAP template and governance model, the role will support business operations, deliver approved enhancements, participate in rollout activities, and promote adoption of standardized Quote\-to\-Cash processes. The position operates under the governance and design authority of the Global SAP CoE, ensuring alignment with global standards, best practices, and template integrity.

---------------------------------


* Serve as the primary SAP SD Regional Consultant supporting business units across the Americas region.
* Act as the primary point of contact for SAP SD production support, incident resolution, service requests, and operational stabilization activities.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand business requirements and assess alignment with approved global template capabilities.
* Ensure all solutions, enhancements, and process recommendations comply with approved global SAP templates, standards, and governance policies.
* Configure and support SAP SD processes including:
* + Customer and Sales Master Data
	+ Quotations
	+ Sales Orders
	+ Sales Contracts
	+ Pricing
	+ ATP (Available\-to\-Promise)
	+ Delivery Processing
	+ Billing
	+ Returns Management
	+ Credit Management

**PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE**
-----------------------


**Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the Sales and Distribution (SD) module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Quote\-to\-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post\-go\-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


**KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES**
---------------------------------


* Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP SD (Sales and Distribution) module configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested \& deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
* Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects \& leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance \& product management workstreams.
* Analyse business requirements related to sales quotations, sales orders management, order fulfilment, invoicing, returns and credit management processes.
* Configure core SD components such as sales order types, item categories, ATP, pricing procedures, delivery types, billing types and work with technical teams for WRICEF developments
* Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
* Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go\-live and hyper care activities.
* Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.
* Collaborate with BRIM, MM, FI, PP and EWM module consultants to support cross\-functional processes.

**SELECTION CRITERIA**

**Essential:**

* Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 15 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
* Minimum 4 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs \& support experience in Sales \& Distribution module in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects.
* Extensive experience in the core SD customizing including Quotations, Sales contracts, Sales order management, Available to Promise (ATP), outbound logistics, pricing, billing and returns and credit management.
* Hands\-on experience in SD configurations.
* Understanding on SAP Best Practices in SD module and their integrations \& technology.
* Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
* Strong communication skills in English, self\-driven and motivated.
* Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline

**Desirable:**


* SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP SD.
* Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
* Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS**

* Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
* Health and Safety accountability statements.
* Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.
